EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
A regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Commerce City was called to order by Mayor Huseman on December 4, 2023, at 6:00 PM.

A motion was made by Council Member Hurst, seconded by Council Member Ford, to excuse those members not present. VOTE: 7 - Aye, 2 - Excused (Allen-Thomas, Madera)
The Pledge of Allegiance was recited.
A motion was made by Council Member Hurst, seconded by Council Member Kim, to adopt the agenda as presented. VOTE: 7 - Aye, 2 - Excused (Allen-Thomas, Madera)
City Manager Rogers highlighted items presented in their weekly report provided to council earlier. The mayor and council reported on their attendance at various meetings and events.
Council Member Madera joined the meeting at 7:00 pm.

A motion was made by Council Member Hurst, seconded by Council Member Kim, to adjourn the meeting. VOTE: 7 - Aye, 2 - Excused (Allen-Thomas, Madera)

The meeting adjourned at 8:04 PM.

In accord with the city charter, the city clerk read the title to all ordinances and resolutions adopted by Council at this meeting.


_________________________________
Jordan D. Roberts, Deputy City Clerk

EventItems.EventItemActionText: A motion was made by Council Member Noble, seconded by Council Member Kim, to enter into executive session pursuant to C.R.S. sec. 24-6-402(4)(b) for the purpose of conferring with the legal counsel to receive legal advice with regard to litigation, specifically the matter of Clinton Nichols v.
